patterns: APPSC asks direct items: who decides a Money Bill (Speaker), President who was Speaker (N. Sanjiva Reddy), first woman Speaker (Meira Kumar), current RS Deputy Chairman (Harivansh).
APPSC Group-1 tests the ending devices: adjournment / sine die (presiding officer) vs prorogation / dissolution (President); Group-2 tests the six-month gap (Art. 85).

Other PSCs recur on resignation to Deputy Speaker, removal by majority of all then members with 14 days' notice, Speaker continuing after dissolution, pro-tem Speaker administering oath, joint sitting presided by Speaker.
Trap: during own-removal resolution the Speaker cannot preside but can speak and vote in the first instance (UPSC 2024).
App bank is heavy on Article-number match lists and statement A/B pairs, with several overlapping Pro-Tem and resignation items; APPSC stays at single-fact level.
